summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys found out that each morning new trash are appearing at the site where there used to be a garbage bin. Meanwhile, there is an arguement between Beika shopping center store association members about whether they should use store association budget to reinstall new garbage bin. At the same moment, Ran's teacher asked the class to submit ideas for entertaining the guests coming to Tokyo for WSG.

suspects: Beika shopping center store association members, crows
suspectsZh: 米花购物中心商户联合会成员、乌鸦
